messages:
tara: secret-scanner hit on a partner deployment artifact containing a PEM and a ci-kms label in the same archive: gs://partner-drop/2026-04-02/deploy.tar.gz -> member keys/gh_app.pem (blob id ffa1). potential exposure :rotating_light:

secret-scanner: pattern: '-----BEGIN (RSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----' + 'ci-kms-ciphertext=' in same archive. confidence 0.94.

josh: ack. initial triage: does the PEM map to a GitHub App or a service key? any nearby metadata?

tara: metadata shows "app_installation=7701" and CI job id. likely GH App private key. also see 'transit:ciphertext=' marker in a sibling file.

leo: containment plan (short): 1) block/uninstall app installation; 2) rotate app private key + revoke installation tokens; 3) snapshot evidence to gs://sec-evidence/4998887777/ (read-only); 4) overwrite exposed blobs with redacted placeholder; 5) tighten Vault/KMS unwrap RBAC to rotation-sa only; 6) if unwrap could be called by CI SA, revoke/rotate those tokens.

ivy: I'm taking evidence copy and scrub job now. copying originals to evidence bucket and uploading stub: "REDACTED: private key removed by security. contact security@redwood.com ref 4998887777". retention 90d.

josh: I'll start GH App key rotation and revoke installation tokens once new key uploaded. sample: openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out ghapp_new.pem -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096

leo: Vault notes: push temporary policy restricting transit/rewrap/unwrap to 'rotation-sa' and remove unwrap from 'ci-runner-sa'. PR includes 12h auto-rollback annotation. after rotation we can rewrap ciphertexts with new key version.

ivy: partner SRE notified, they acknowledged and will delete local artifacts. asked for scrub manifest; shared read-only evidence link.

josh: scan GH audit logs for token minting/activity from installation 7701 in last 72h and flag suspicious calls. will escalate if we see token creation.

legal-bot: received. legal requests affected partner name, blob ids, timeline, and whether tokens were minted. hold public disclosure until scope confirmed.

tara: timeline estimate: 0-30m block/uninstall; 30-120m rotate key + revoke tokens; 2-6h scrub + evidence; 6-24h RBAC tighten + rewrap if needed; 24-72h audit and postmortem. I'll update here as milestones complete. :white_check_mark:
